import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -2")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 8 --nostream 2>&1 | tail -6")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
